BERT4Rec’s Cloze loss reconstructs masked items using left and right context; terminal inference instead predicts an appended mask. This creates a documented objective mismatch, but does not establish gradient conflict in a particular checkpoint. [BERT4Rec](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.06690) and [Recency Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.02643) motivate comparing interior-mask and terminal-mask supervision. Proposed bounded probe: on fixed training minibatches, compute each loss’s per-layer gradient norms, missing-gradient flags, and cosine similarity on shared parameters. Negative cosine indicates local directional conflict; disconnected gradients require separate checks, and zero gradients alone do not prove disconnection. [PCGrad](https://arxiv.org/abs/2001.06782) supplies the gradient-conflict framework.

The 2024 [activation-patching best-practices study](https://proceedings.iclr.cc/paper_files/paper/2024/hash/06a52a54c8ee03cd86771136bc91eb1f-Abstract-Conference.html) shows that corruption methods and measurement choices can substantially change localization results. Proposed BERT4Rec adaptation: remove or replace right context around interior masks, then restore individual layer activations and measure target-logit margins and loss recovery. Include clean-to-clean identity patches, corrupted controls, raw score changes, and multiple corruptions; avoid normalized recovery when the clean–corrupted gap is near zero. Interior-mask sensitivity demonstrates future-context reliance during reconstruction, not necessarily leakage at terminal inference.

Validate these probes with temporary, isolated faults: detach the supervised hidden state, zero an objective’s weight, expose a masked target, or select an incorrect padded readout. Require the expected diagnostic response and clean-control stability. This adapts [DeepMutation’s](https://arxiv.org/abs/1805.05206) fault-injection principle; it is a proposed diagnostic protocol, not an established BERT4Rec result. Restore every intervention afterward, perform no optimizer steps, and retain one trained checkpoint per category.
